content_html:
watched #SKANDA : Nolan gadi movies decode cheyatam kadhuraaaa…..meeku dammunte maa Boyaaa anna Skanda decode cheyandi 🙏🙏🙏

This is how the product is made when the makers think that their audience are senseless….Agreed that there are many out and out illogical mass masala movies which have become blockbusters in recent past but they were successful in grabbing the audience attention in at-least one or other department and thus making them completely forget about the logics and enjoy what is shown, but unfortunately in Skanda you get disconnected right from the first scene itself and the there is no point of getting reconnected to the movie or the plot.

When you establish the Hero’s character as a Foreign University Topper and outstanding Ethical Hacker…then the least we expect is that he uses his INTELLIGENCE in cornering the Villains (in this case 2 states CM’s 🤣😉) BUT BUT BUT thats Nolans way of movie making but in Boya’s way the heros just flexes his muscle power and thats it 🙏

Looks like all the action scenes where choreographed by Mutton Kottu Masthan 🤣 Generally Thaman has this ability to take an ordinary scene to next level with his BGM and that has become a huge minus for this movie as the scenes were already Over the Top and with his BGM they were just unbearable 🫡

Taking wise the movie is shot in typical Boya’s style where the screen is filled with hundreds of character artists whose only duty is to get dressed and give over expressions and deliver over the top dialogues praising the Hero/Villan 🙏

The only positives about this movie are Ram’s Looks and Ram-Sreeleela’s dances!!! Except them everything else is unbearable
